name: Road Life

description.content: While injured and repairing a Generator:

items: Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn [1] Token.
Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose [1] Token.

description.content: When you have [4] Tokens, you can heal yourself. Spend all Tokens to heal yourself [10%] faster. When you stop healing, this ends after [4s].

quote: "Remind me to teach you how to patch your own pedals, Krit." -Vee Boonyasak
